feeds.title: Just Add Ice Blog
feeds.description: Just Add Ice Phalaenopsis orchids are easy to care for with our ice-cube watering method. Discover exclusive orchid care tips & home decor trends. Follow this blog to get Orchid care tips for watering Phalaenopsis orchids with ice.

feeds.title: Brooklyn Orchids
feeds.description: Brooklyn Orchids is a personal blog dedicated to all things orchids! Follow my blog to learn how to care for orchids includes determining when and how to fertilize them. Find out why orchids need fertilizer, how to pick an orchid fertilizer, and how often to feed them.

feeds.title: My World of Orchids
feeds.description: Here you will find photographs of my small orchid collection. I've been keeping orchids since 1998 after acquiring a few specimens. I was warned by fellow hobbyists that orchids are addictive. Follow my blog and just see my orchid collection now!!

feeds.title: Orchid Man in the United Kingdom
feeds.description: Spending my free time in mastering the difficult art of growing orchids, as well as trying to share my knowledge with people around me in the United Kingdom and further. Follow my blog to get knowledge on growing orchids.

feeds.title: Maria's Orchids
feeds.description: A photo journal about growing orchids. I am a biomedical research scientist, and an avid orchid enthusiast, living in New York.

feeds.title: Orchideria
feeds.description: Amanda teaches people who are new to growing orchids how to care for these fascinating flowers. Orchideria is about cultivating orchids and creating terrariums.

feeds.title: Orchid Bliss
feeds.description: I am so glad you're here! I'm Anna. I'm a writer and editor turned orchid lover. All about growing orchids. Learn everything you need to know to re-bloom orchids. Including my #1 tip. Follow my blog to get updates on growing orchids and orchid care.
